column1: # Cause map for imx8mp-gles3-compare.py: <cause id> TAB <glob over the dEQP-GLES3 case name> TAB <short title>
# The first matching line wins, so a narrow line goes before a wide one. A case no line matches is
# 'unclassified'. A cause may have several lines. '*' also matches '.' (fnmatch).
# Seeded from RC1-RC18 of docs/es3-cts-failures.md: the causes that apply to the GC7000UL (Vivante)
# and the generic ones; the PowerVR-only (RC6, RC15, RC16) and closed (RC4, RC12) causes are left
# out. Conservative: a group the RC section does not name stays unclassified.
# CRC-16 pair mates of the 9bc82915 page records: a failing CRC that names two cases inside the row's filter is listed
# under both names, and these are the names that did not fail. Exact names, so they go before every glob that holds
# them (default_vertex_attrib.*, shaders.constant_expressions.*, shaders.conversions.*, shaders.random.*). e2 and e47 are
# resolved in their slice READMEs; the e27 two by the host: their mates precision.step.lowp_vertex.vec3 and
# precision.transpose.highp_vertex.mat4x2 fail on the host with a GL error (executor), and every such case of e27's nine
# precision groups is named on the board without them, so the CRC slot is theirs.
